plugins.name: mg-video
plugins.description: Motion-graphics clips in code: 15 style cards, one beat sheet for picture and sound, measurable checks, independent review.

description: mg-video: make a polished motion-graphics (MG) clip in code. Pick one of 15 style cards, write a prompt from a template, build key-frame stills first, animate a web page (or a Blender scene) frame by frame, place music and synthesized sound effects from the same beat sheet, check the encoded film with fixed-definition scripts, and revise until an independent reviewer passes it.
